chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Chapter 542: The Supreme Guankou’s Secret Economy
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang trades secrets with the Supreme Guankou for a weapon against the Dice, paying in karmic debt and a hidden sigil. A turning point in the chase.
og_title: Enough Secrets for Another Secret – Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 542
og_description: Li Huowang barters secrets with a cosmic dealer and finally gets a one-shot tool to find the Dice. But the price is written in karmic ink.
twitter_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian 542: The Supreme Guankou Deal
twitter_description: Li Huowang trades a fan’s dangerous secret for a third eye that can locate the Dice. Perfect, right? …Right?

lore_anchors.definition: A supernatural entity that only trades secrets for secrets. It communicates through reflections and evaluates the value of information with cosmic precision.
A type of Tang Dynasty glazed pottery known for its three-color palette. Here used to describe the unnerving, ceramic-like quality of a false reflection.
A class of high-dimensional fate deities in the Dao-Twisted World; any secret involving them carries direct karmic consequences.
In Daoist and Buddhist cosmology, the principle of cause and effect; in this world, learning about a Siming ties your fate to theirs.
A rare human constitution that makes the bearer a living alchemical ingredient; considered a valuable secret by the Supreme Guankou.
Li Huowang’s ability to manifest illusions as tangible objects; used here to make Zhuge Yuan’s fan physically real.
The highest-ranking official of the Supervisory Heavenly Office; a potential ally against the Dice.
